title: SLAM Handbook: From Localization and Mapping to Spatial Intelligence
summary: Edited community handbook covering SLAM foundations (factor graphs, state representations), sensor-specific pipelines (visual, LiDAR, inertial, leg odometry) and spatial AI topics such as learned SLAM and NeRF/Gaussian-splatting maps. Released openly in parts before the Cambridge University Press edition.
key_takeaways: Single up-to-date reference spanning classic estimation and learned methods
Free chapter PDFs on GitHub

title: Past, Present, and Future of Simultaneous Localization And Mapping: Towards the Robust-Perception Age
summary: Landmark survey that frames modern SLAM as factor-graph MAP estimation and discusses robustness, scalability, representations and open problems.
key_takeaways: Standard framing of front end vs back end
Robustness to outliers and long-term operation remain the hard problems

title: Visual-Inertial Navigation: A Concise Review
summary: Compact review of visual-inertial navigation: filtering vs optimization, observability, calibration and representative systems.
key_takeaways: Explains why MSCKF-style filters and sliding-window optimizers coexist
Observability and consistency drive estimator design

title: ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual-Inertial and Multi-Map SLAM
summary: Describes ORB-SLAM3's tightly integrated visual-inertial SLAM, MAP-based IMU initialization and the multi-map Atlas that recovers from tracking loss.
key_takeaways: Multi-map atlas lets the system restart and later merge maps
Supports pinhole and fisheye models

title: VINS-Mono: A Robust and Versatile Monocular Visual-Inertial State Estimator
summary: Presents the VINS-Mono estimator: IMU preintegration, robust initialization, tightly coupled sliding-window optimization, relocalization and global pose graph.
key_takeaways: Monocular camera + IMU recovers metric scale
Initialization is a key practical component

title: FAST-LIO2: Fast Direct LiDAR-inertial Odometry
summary: Introduces direct registration of raw LiDAR points in an iterated Kalman filter with an incremental k-d tree map, avoiding hand-crafted feature extraction.
key_takeaways: Raw-point registration generalizes across LiDAR types
ikd-Tree enables efficient incremental mapping

title: LIO-SAM: Tightly-coupled Lidar Inertial Odometry via Smoothing and Mapping
summary: Formulates LiDAR-inertial odometry as factor-graph smoothing with IMU preintegration, LiDAR odometry, GPS and loop-closure factors.
key_takeaways: Factor graphs make it straightforward to add or drop GNSS
Keyframe-local scan matching keeps it real time

title: KISS-ICP: In Defense of Point-to-Point ICP -- Simple, Accurate, and Robust Registration If Done the Right Way
summary: Argues that a carefully engineered point-to-point ICP with motion compensation and adaptive thresholds matches far more complex LiDAR odometry across platforms.
key_takeaways: Few parameters, works across sensors and platforms
Strong baseline before reaching for complex pipelines

title: FAST-LIVO2: Fast, Direct LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry
summary: Presents an error-state iterated Kalman filter that sequentially fuses LiDAR and image measurements against a shared voxel map, with exposure and plane-prior handling.
key_takeaways: Sequential updates handle LiDAR/camera dimension mismatch
Robust when one modality degrades

title: DROID-SLAM: Deep Visual SLAM for Monocular, Stereo, and RGB-D Cameras
summary: Learned SLAM that iteratively refines poses and depth through a differentiable dense bundle adjustment layer.
key_takeaways: Big robustness gains on hard sequences
GPU-heavy

title: MASt3R-SLAM: Real-Time Dense SLAM with 3D Reconstruction Priors
summary: Builds a real-time dense monocular SLAM system on the MASt3R two-view reconstruction prior, without assuming a fixed parametric camera model.
key_takeaways: 3D foundation models can serve as SLAM front ends
Works with uncalibrated video

title: Kimera: an Open-Source Library for Real-Time Metric-Semantic Localization and Mapping
summary: Describes the Kimera stack: VIO, robust pose-graph optimization, mesh reconstruction and semantic mapping in one open library.
key_takeaways: Metric-semantic maps on CPU in real time
Modular: VIO, RPGO, mesher, semantics

title: Kimera-Multi: Robust, Distributed, Dense Metric-Semantic SLAM for Multi-Robot Systems
summary: Distributed multi-robot SLAM where robots exchange compact information peer to peer and jointly optimize with outlier-robust distributed pose-graph optimization.
key_takeaways: Peer-to-peer, no central server
Robust to bad inter-robot loop closures

title: Swarm-SLAM: Sparse Decentralized Collaborative Simultaneous Localization and Mapping Framework for Multi-Robot Systems
summary: Decentralized collaborative SLAM aimed at swarms, prioritizing which inter-robot loop closures to compute and share to limit communication.
key_takeaways: Communication budget is a first-class design constraint
Supports LiDAR, stereo and RGB-D

title: Event-based Vision: A Survey
summary: Comprehensive survey of event cameras: sensing principle, algorithms (feature tracking, optical flow, VO/SLAM) and applications.
key_takeaways: Microsecond latency and high dynamic range
Algorithms must be redesigned for asynchronous data

title: How NeRFs and 3D Gaussian Splatting are Reshaping SLAM: a Survey
summary: Survey of SLAM methods that use neural radiance fields or 3D Gaussian splatting as the map representation, organized by sensor and technique.
key_takeaways: Radiance-field maps trade compute for photorealism
Most methods are GPU-bound and not yet embedded-ready

title: Gaussian Splatting SLAM
summary: Monocular and RGB-D SLAM that tracks and maps directly against 3D Gaussians using analytic Jacobians for camera pose optimization.
key_takeaways: Single representation for tracking, mapping and rendering

title: LiDAR Odometry Survey: Recent Advancements and Remaining Challenges
summary: Survey of LiDAR-only, LiDAR-inertial and multi-sensor LiDAR odometry, with discussion of datasets, evaluation and open challenges such as degeneracy.
key_takeaways: Taxonomy of LiDAR, LiDAR-inertial and LiDAR-plus-other fusion
Geometric degeneracy (tunnels, open fields) is a key open issue

title: 4D Millimeter-Wave Radar in Autonomous Driving: A Survey
summary: Survey of 4D imaging radar: signal processing, datasets, calibration, perception and SLAM/odometry uses.
key_takeaways: 4D radar adds elevation and works in adverse weather
Sparse, noisy point clouds need radar-specific methods

title: CFEAR Radarodometry - Conservative Filtering for Efficient and Accurate Radar Odometry
summary: Learning-free spinning-radar odometry that keeps the strongest returns per azimuth, builds oriented surface points and registers against a keyframe history (IROS 2021).
key_takeaways: Simple filtering beats heavier radar pipelines
Runs fast on a single CPU thread per the authors

title: Edge-based Monocular Thermal-Inertial Odometry in Visually Degraded Environments
summary: Thermal-inertial odometry that tracks thermal image edges instead of corner features, targeting darkness and smoke where visible cameras fail.
key_takeaways: Thermal edges are more stable than corners in low-contrast IR
Relevant for night and obscurant operations
